title: Clearer player statistics and friend access
body:
- The admin overview now separates participating account and guest-browser identities from saved sessions, excluding inactive account states from participant counts.
- Searchable game rows show larger per-mode counts and provide direct access to session details.
- New Continental guest guesses are associated with the same browser identity as questions. Older anonymous guesses remain unidentified.
- Fixed saving verified Flagdle questions so they contribute to gameplay history and participation.
- Added a Play with friend button to the homepage and improved the loading experience on reload.
